item_name: Rothco Deluxe POW/MIA Low Profile Cap
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Deluxe POW/MIA Low Profile Cap is made from a durable 100% brushed cotton twill, featuring a raised 3-D embroidered POW/MIA insignia on the front panel as well as “POW*MIA” on the brim. This military hat also features a hook and loop closure in back for adjustability.
